findings.message: apps/server/src/MatchRoom.ts keeps a module-level `outcomes: MatchOutcome[]` array. `endMatch` pushes every finished match's full MatchResults onto it and never removes any, including in the production entry (DEFAULT_MATCH_TUNING, main.ts). `recordedOutcomes()` is only read by tests and diagnostics. So a long-running production server's memory grows by one entry for every match it ever finishes. The fix is to bound it (a ring buffer, or a test-only switch like `testHooks`) or hand outcomes to a store and drop them.
